values.note: Bergland Township: sites with hookups $25 a night, $550 a month or $1,600 a season; one rate for everyone. $3 non-refundable fee per reservation. Cancelling under 48 hours out forfeits $10 and the first night.

fees.source: https://berglandmi.gov/campground ('Sites with hookups – $25/night, $550/month, or $1,600/season', 'There is a $3 fee for each reservation'), read 2026-10-25

values.note: Lower sites 1-13 have 30-amp, upper sites A-G 20-amp. Water spigots at some sites may be used only to fill tanks, not as a continuous hookup (Health Department).

note: Bergland Township park on Bergland Bay of Lake Gogebic (local government; RV Life mislabels as city). Lower campground on mostly level gravel spurs; upper campground heavily wooded, some sites hard to reach or unlevel. Sand beach, playground; DNR dock and boat launch a short walk south. Generators prohibited. Distinct from the county-run Ontonagon County Park to the south. --Claude
